controls.title: Verify actor and configuration
controls.expected: Fresh intended login/session identity; role, tenant, entity/domain, module, location/brand, tax/costing/approval/clock settings verified. Names/sidebar alone do not identify actor.

controls.title: Known foreign record denial
controls.expected: Run valid own positive and known existing foreign record/object with foreign positive. Cover read/write/export/cache/file boundaries. No foreign data or cross-tenant business mutation.

controls.title: Effective role/module/scope
controls.expected: Own authorized same-action positive; Viewer/revoked/suspended/restricted role denial on real record. No denied financial/document/stock/allocation/business CREATE effect; telemetry policy separate.

controls.title: Dates and closed periods
controls.expected: Try before/on/after configured period boundary with actual server check, stale form and correction path. Invalid/locked dates do not post; source history retained.

controls.title: Intent identity and ambiguous response
controls.expected: Double click/reload/back/timeout after commit; inspect persisted state before replay. At most one accepted effect per declared identity; different-key duplicate policy explicitly reviewed.

controls.title: Independent concurrent connections
controls.expected: Contend for final stock/capacity/balance in isolated infrastructure. Assert both results and persisted conservation; Promise.all on one fake transaction does not prove a race.

controls.title: Durable boundary atomicity
controls.expected: Ephemeral approved fault at each relevant header/line/stock/journal/allocation/object/audit boundary. Assert rollback or explicit resumable contract, preserve first failure; no shared staging fault injection.

controls.title: Snapshots and configuration transition
controls.expected: Rename/reprice/reclassify/toggle settings after posting, reopen stale draft and inspect history/print/export. Issued facts unchanged; changed draft policy explicit; record required compatibility.

controls.title: Independent readback and reconciliation
controls.expected: Reload persisted records and reconcile exact account/amount/tax/date/tenant/domain/location, stock quantity/value, AR/AP/deposit/fleet, P&L/BS/as-of and source/audit links as applicable.

controls.title: Truthful form and recovery
controls.expected: Required fields, invalid input, browser submit variants, retained errors/inputs, busy overlay clearing, read-only receipt recovery and keyboard/navigation. Route load or screenshot alone is not correctness.

controls.title: Files and exports
controls.expected: Applicable record attachments, private object authorization before signing, actual bytes/MIME/limits, safe text export, replacement failure and orphan cleanup; exact thresholds pinned from supported configuration.

controls.title: Tax and legal applicability
controls.expected: Confirm stored classifications, registration, entity/framework, effective source date and expert decision. Synthetic rate arithmetic does not certify legal eligibility; unknown support blocks affected acceptance.

controls.title: Prior-version preservation
controls.expected: Actual prior-release golden records/files upgraded under supported migrations; semantic counts/balances/identity and files preserved. Fresh current schema alone is not upgrade evidence.

controls.title: Data boundaries and precision
controls.expected: Explicit zero/negative/at/below/above monetary/quantity/date/length limits, Unicode/whitespace and unsupported enums. Use exact supported bounds; no invented normalization or money from malformed input.
